newsitem.title: UK: London ship insurers invoke Albania war exclusion.
newsitem.headline: London ship insurers invoke Albania war exclusion.

text.p: Marine insurance underwriters at Lloyd's of London and the Institute of London Underwriters have excluded ships in or near Albania from protection against war damage under their standard policies, according to a market statement.

With effect from March 20, Albania will be added to the areas listed under the London insurance market's War Risks Trading Warranties, meaning an additional war premium has to be negotiated with insurers and reinsurers for ships trading to, deviating towards, or sailing within Albanian territorial waters.
The move was triggered by "the continuing civil strife in the country and the evacuation of foreigners," the statement from the London War Risks Rating Committee said.

It added that for sailings or flights on or after 1600GMT on Tuesday March 18, Albania is put on a 'held covered' basis for Cargo War & Strikes Risks (Marine and Air), meaning that insurance against losses to cargo stemming from war or strike are put at the discretion of the policy underwriter.
Lloyd's and London market underwriters also issued a General Notice of Cancellation, meaning clauses which allow cancellation of insurance and reinsurance in war risk areas can be invoked.
The notice takes effect at 2400 GMT on Thursday March 20.
